claim_boundary: does not handle secrets or credentials
does not prove every future agent will classify correctly

cases.action_summary: Inspect repository branch, git status, PR state, CI state, comments, and relevant files.
cases.acceptance_gate: Read-only state facts are recorded without edits, pushes, external effects, or stronger claims.

cases.action_summary: Edit low-risk AOOS docs, schemas, fixtures, reports, and validation anchors inside an existing PR branch.
cases.evidence_requirement: L2 diff and L3 local checks
cases.acceptance_gate: Scoped diff is reversible, locally checked, and avoids unrelated files.

cases.action_summary: Commit and push a scoped low-risk change to a non-main working branch and update PR metadata.
cases.evidence_requirement: L2 commit plus L3 CI when available
cases.acceptance_gate: Only intended files are staged, branch is non-main, CI is reported honestly, and PR remains review-gated.
cases.rollback_path: push a corrective commit or revert the scoped commit

cases.action_summary: Auto-merge an eligible low-risk PR only if explicit repository policy allows every auto-merge criterion.
cases.evidence_requirement: L3 CI plus explicit repository policy and rollback evidence
cases.acceptance_gate: Auto-merge is blocked unless policy explicitly allows it and all low-risk, check, evidence, rollback, and no-fake-completion criteria pass.
cases.rollback_path: revert merge commit if human-authorized merge later causes regression
forbidden_actions: merge after failed or missing CI
merge when real-world or credential boundary is involved

cases.action_summary: Run reversible local sandbox checks with no customer, money, account, legal, production, or external-platform consequence.
cases.evidence_requirement: L1 local output and rollback note
cases.acceptance_gate: Operation stays local/test-only, reversible, and produces no real-world side effects.
cases.rollback_path: delete local generated sandbox outputs or revert scoped repository fixture changes

cases.action_summary: Prepare real-world action drafts, outreach packets, deployment plans, or feedback-ingestion packets without executing them.
cases.evidence_requirement: L0 proposal until source records exist
cases.acceptance_gate: Packet is clearly marked draft/proposal and does not contact users, customers, accounts, platforms, or external systems.
cases.rollback_path: remove or revise the proposal packet before merge if it blurs the boundary

cases.action_summary: Execute production deployment, customer outreach, payment/refund/revenue action, legal/commercial claim, credential action, destructive deletion, direct main push, merge without preauthorization, or external service/permission introduction.
cases.evidence_requirement: L4 explicit human authorization before action and L5 source records after real-world outcome
cases.acceptance_gate: No action occurs until explicit owner authorization defines exact scope, target, rollback, and evidence requirement.
cases.rollback_path: owner-defined rollback plan required before execution
forbidden_actions: claim real-world outcome before source evidence
